nom: Naked Sundays CabanaGlow Glow Drops SPF 50 Sunscreen

segments.oily: A reviewer with oily, hyperpigmentation-prone skin liked the zinc formula but found it highly pigmented and slow to sink in over a mineral sunscreen; another says the product gives a glow without feeling oily.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with very sensitive, acne-prone skin found it lightweight and moisturizing all day, and another bought it for her pre-teen daughter's sensitive skin, but a different reviewer reports the mineral bronzing drops caused eye irritation when it got in her eyes.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her mid-fifties reports it moisturizes, protects, and makes her skin look great.
segments.dry: One reviewer says the product is not drying, unlike other mineral sunscreens she has used.
segments.normal: A pale-skinned reviewer with no specific skin concerns describes it as sheer, comfortable, and effective with no sunburn even on a tropical vacation.

concerns.aging: A mature-skin reviewer (mid-50s) reports it moisturizes, protects, and leaves her skin looking great, with no complaints noted.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe it as moisturizing or hydrating and not drying; one specifically contrasts it with other mineral sunscreens that dried out her skin.
concerns.redness: No reviewer specifically discusses redness or irritation calming; one unrelated case reports eye irritation rather than facial redness.
concerns.barrier: Not discussed directly by reviewers in terms of barrier repair.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation liked the zinc content but found the tint too pigmented and slow-absorbing on her fair skin, needing to mix it with another product to tone it down.
concerns.blemishes: A reviewer with acne-prone skin found it kept her skin moisturized without breakouts; another reports it made her flaky, breakout, textured chin look better than ever under concealer, though no one describes new breakouts from the product itself.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers say it gives a glow without feeling oily or greasy; however, two reviewers explicitly describe the formula itself as greasy on application.

aspects.libelle: Highly pigmented, hard to blend on fair skin
Pairs well under makeup without pilling

extraits.texte: I have hyperpigmentation and somewhat oily skin, so i love products that include zinc. This is a really pretty shade (peachy pink) and very glowy/sparkly. That said, its highly pigmented and the smallest amount (less than 1 drop) looks super intense on my fair skin. It works if i mix it with beautyscreen, but id rather not have to do that. On a positive note, the bottle will last forever haha It also isnt setting- if I lightly touch my face an hour after i apply it (and setting powder), my finger will still come away with product. Its possible that its not sinking in because i have mineral sunscreen underneath, but im not sure. While this product didnt work for me, i still love naked sundays (especially the beautyscreen) and will probably see if their blush sticks work better for me.

I have very sensitive acne prone skin and always go for a natural dewy makeup look and its def worth it i like how it made me glow . Its very lightweight on my skin it kept me moisturized all day and i love that it has spf !! Definitely my go to in my routine now

extraits.titre: Shocked how good! Better makeup application
extraits.texte: I bought this during 21 Days Sale. I'm only using mineral sunscreens now. This made my flaky, breakout, textured chin area appear better than EVER after applying shape tape concealer on top. I am so impressed!
Bought it for my pre-teen daughter as part of her morning routine. It has just enough shimmer that she's excited to wear it every day. Love that its mineral and kind to her sensitive skin!

This product is perfect. It's extremely comfortable and protects extremely well: I am very pale and live in a region with a lot of cloud cover. I used it as my only facial sunscreen on a tropical vacation anddidn't get the faintest hint of a sunburn. It makes my skin look amazing, and I constantly get compliments when I am wearing it. I wear it every single day with great joy.

I'm an outdoor gal(hike, golf, boat, paddle board and ski). I love this product mixed with two drops of it in bronze, then the blush, I feel put together and protected without looking shabby. It moisturizes, protects and my skin looks great for 56. Thank you!

This has been my go to this year. I order a new one as soon as I run out. It gives me a lovely glow with no glitter and zero white cast. Unlike other mineral sunscreens, it's not drying. I bought it for some of my friends as well. Highly recommend!
